column1: #  - only forms at the top of the file or directly inside a module, module* or module+ form count; a define in a function body, let, when or for is a local;
#  - module, module* and module+ are packages;

#  - define with a parameter list is a function (curried, keyword and rest arguments included), and so are define/contract, define-inline, define-syntax, define-syntax-rule and (define f (lambda ..)) or (define f (λ ..)): macros are functions;
#  - any other (define name value) is a variable; each name of define-values is a variable;
#  - struct and define-struct are classes (accessors and fields are not held);
#  - (define C (class ..)) is a class; the define/public, define/private, define/override ... forms directly in its body are methods, a plain define there (a field) is not;
#  - define-generics is an interface and each method it lists is a method;
#  - require, provide, define-logger and calls are not definitions.
